FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Line Standing
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Drill with any colonist. Both stop, stand apart, and run through a route or a contact drill. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Go over tradecraft with another colonist on the line. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Review a lower-ranked agent's gear and cover story for holes. A clean story earns trust, a shaky one earns a warning.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Assign a lower-ranked agent a stretch of tedious dead-drop runs for a lapse in tradecraft, souring their mood. Once per day per colonist.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Signal every combat-ranked agent among {0} on this map to move fast and quiet. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to a rally point behind you, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They hold until stood down.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Scatter {0} from the rally point, letting them return to their duties.
